title: Sliding Networks: A Family of Residual Structures Preserving Feature Learning and Feature Diversity
abstract: arXiv:2610.33840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep learning models tend to perform best at large widths and depths. The growing interest in scaling laws, especially in the language modeling domain, has motivated procedures for scaling up network widths and depths in order to preserve stability and computational efficiency of training dynamics. Existing depth-scaling approaches force a choice between retaining locally maximal \emph{feature learning} and preserving a form of \emph{feature diversity} in the residual stream arising from random differences between channels. We examine a \textit{joint scaling recipe} that preserves both. With residual width $N_\flat$, hidden width $N_\sharp$, and depth $L$, the key quantity is, by default, the limiting ratio $N_\flat/(N_\sharp L)\to\alpha$, while correlated initialization (Half Copy) can partially relax the resulting shape constraints. translated_title: 滑动网络：一类保持特征学习与特征多样性的残差结构
translated_abstract: 深度学习模型通常在较大的宽度和深度下表现最佳。对缩放定律日益增长的兴趣，尤其是在语言建模领域，促使人们研究扩展网络宽度和深度的方法，以保持训练动力学的稳定性与计算效率。现有的深度扩展方法迫使我们二选一：要么保留局部最大化的“特征学习”，要么保留残差流中由通道间随机差异产生的某种“特征多样性”。我们研究了一种能够同时保留两者的联合缩放方案。以残差宽度 $N_\flat$、隐藏宽度 $N_\sharp$ 和深度 $L$ 表示，默认的关键量是极限比值 $N_\flat/(N_\sharp L)\to\alpha$，而相关初始化（Half Copy，半拷贝）可以部分放宽由此产生的形状约束。理论和残差MLP实验支持在固定正 $\alpha$ 下收敛到一个 SDE 极限……
tldr: 提出滑动网络——一类联合缩放的残差结构，通过控制极限比值 $N_\flat/(N_\sharp L)\to\alpha$（并可借助Half Copy相关初始化部分放宽约束），在扩展网络深度时同时保持特征学习与特征多样性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Sliding Networks, a family of jointly scaled residual structures that preserves both feature learning and feature diversity when scaling network depth, via the limiting ratio $N_\flat/(N_\sharp L)\to\alpha$ and Half Copy correlated initialization.
